_comment: Example MCP config for Defold Engine integration. This is a template - you need to install a compatible Defold MCP server first. Defold MCP tooling is community-driven and evolving.
_tools_provided: defold_build - Build and run the project (bob.jar / editor)
defold_edit_script - Create or edit a .script / .lua file
defold_run - Launch the project and capture output
_setup_instructions: 1. Install a Defold MCP server (community, e.g. defold-mcp-server)
2. Set DEFOLD_PATH to your Defold editor / bob.jar location
3. Set PROJECT_PATH to your Defold project root (the folder with game.project)
4. Add this config to your Claude Code MCP settings
